item.title: Google DeepMind Unionization Talks Are Off to a Rocky Start
item.description: During negotiations on Wednesday, employees voiced frustrations with what they consider an unwillingness among executives to engage meaningfully with the prospect of unionization.

item.title: Can Cursor Remain a Platform for OpenAI and Anthropic’s Models Inside SpaceX?
item.description: Cursor hopes to continue offering third-party AI models after it's acquired by SpaceX, testing the relationships between frontier AI labs.

item.title: Meta Is Charging a Subscription for Smart Glasses Features. Welcome to the New Era of Consumer Tech
item.description: You bought the hardware. Now you’ll need to subscribe for “expanded access” to the most advanced features.

item.title: Goose, a New Gay Dating App, Appears to Be a Psyop
item.description: Touted as a less-hookup-focused Grindr, Goose is an invite-only space for gay men. The problem is the people promoting it don’t seem real.

item.title: You Can Now Sound the Alarm on AI Behaving Badly
item.description: Are you worried your AI chatbot is trying to build a bomb or leak personal information about you? There’s a website for that.

item.title: Anthropic Added a New Security Measure to Get Back Into the Trump Administration’s Good Graces
item.description: The government has removed restrictions on Anthropic’s Fable 5 and Mythos 5 AI models—but there were strings attached.

item.title: Claude Helped a Hacker Find a Way to Issue Tickets to Almost Every US Music Festival
item.description: A researcher found that using Anthropic’s Claude Opus 4.7, he could break into the website of Front Gate—used by every festival from Lollapalooza to Bonnaroo—and freely issue any ticket he chose.

item.title: The Trump Administration Is Lifting Its Export Controls on Anthropic’s Mythos and Fable AI Models
item.description: The White House is easing restrictions on Anthropic’s most advanced AI models weeks after ordering the company to suspend access for foreign nationals.

item.title: Bernie Sanders Saw This Coming
item.description: For decades, the senator has argued that concentrated wealth threatened American democracy. Now he’s betting that frustration with Big Tech, billionaires, and unchecked AI is reaching a tipping point.

item.title: Meta Contractors Posed as Teens to Prompt Rival Chatbots About Suicide, Sex, and Drugs
item.description: Hundreds of contractors working on a project for Meta pretended to be kids in order to see how other chatbots like Gemini and ChatGPT would respond to high-risk subjects, WIRED found.
